title: Persistent AttributeError: 'NoneType' has no attribute 'name' (beanie) in FastAPI on Google Cloud Run (Concurrency Issue with Lifespan Initialization)
body:
### First Check

- [X] I added a very descriptive title here.
- [X] I used the GitHub search to find a similar question and didn't find it.
- [x] I searched the FastAPI documentation, with the integrated search.
- [X] I already searched in Google "How to X in FastAPI" and didn't find any information.
- [X] I already read and followed all the tutorial in the docs and didn't find an answer.
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Pydantic](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [Swagger UI](https://github.com/swagger-api/swagger-ui).
- [X] I already checked if it is not related to FastAPI but to [ReDoc](https://github.com/Redocly/redoc).

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app):
    """Initialize application services."""
    app.db = await db()
    print("Startup complete")
    yield
    print("close fastapi")
---
async def db():
    return await init_mongodb(
        document_models=[Doc]
    )
---
async def init_mongodb(document_models:list):
    client = AsyncIOMotorClient(config.MONGODB_URL)
    await init_beanie(
        database=client[config.MONGODB_NAME],
        document_models=document_models
    )
    return client
```


### Description

I am using ​​FastAPI​​ deployed on ​​Google Cloud Run​​ (request-based billing). This error occurs during concurrent requests. Despite initializing resources in the lifespan context manager as suggested in previous issues.
I'm uncertain whether this issue stems from ​​Beanie​​ (MongoDB ODM) or ​​FastAPI's async architecture​​. It would be greatly appreciated if the FastAPI team could provide guidance

### Operating System

Linux

### Operating System Details

_No response_

### FastAPI Version

0.112.4

### Pydantic Version

2.10.6

### Python Version

3.12.6

### Additional Context

_No response_
